dedupe_keys.name: power system small signal modelling tool in matlab university of manchester

description: This tool is a set of MATLAB scripts that automatically builds small-signal models of interconnected power systems with both synchronous generators and power-electronic converters. It was published by the University of Manchester (version 2, 2025) by Luke Benedetti, Agusti Egea and Panagiotis Papadopoulos, developed during a PhD on small-signal dynamics in converter-permeated power systems, and supports several journal and conference papers. Using only parameter data in the example format and a MATPOWER case file, it compiles a model with eighth-order synchronous generation and controls, grid-following and grid-forming converters with several control structures, constant-impedance loads, and lines and transformers, each represented algebraically or dynamically, including stator transients of generators and converter coupling filters. Coverage is not tied to a place. The scripts are downloadable from the university figshare under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: MATPOWER and MATLAB are required, and the authors warn that the scripts may contain errors and should be used with care. Simulation uses are small-signal stability studies of grids with high converter shares, such as probabilistic stability and variability analysis. Related records: model-matpower supplies the network cases, and model-issa-stability-analysis and model-odepower cover related analysis.
